note: Workbook demonstration data, not a live ERP position. Order value is reported twice — at selling price, which is what the A3 sheet totals, and at trade-agreement price, which is what the purchase order would actually cost.

formulas.f01-ads-per-store: base_ads * seasonality * store_size * (1 + demand_lever / 100) * IF(AND(promo_eligible = "Y", promo_lever > 0), 1 + (promo_lever / 100) * 1.3 * (1 - promo_depth), 1)
formulas.f05-rop: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust)))
formulas.f06-maximum-inventory: ROUND(ads * (MAX(1, lead_time_days + lead_time_adjust) + MAX(0, safety_days + safety_adjust) + 4))
